nodes.title: VESTA — Vietnamese Equity Sentiment-Triggered Agent
nodes.content: Research pipeline: score VN news sentiment, cross-check against fundamentals/macro, prove signal on historical data before any execution layer. F0xx (crawlers/ETL) and F1xx (validation/join) tiers complete and re-verified; F2xx (proof backtest) is next.

nodes.title: Tier F0xx — Data Crawlers & ETL (COMPLETE)
nodes.content: F000-F009. All 10 features passing, independently re-verified against the real repo multiple times (122 tests, 121 passed, 1 xfailed at tier close).

nodes.title: Tier F1xx — Validation & Point-in-Time Join (COMPLETE)
nodes.content: F101-F102. Cross-dataset referential integrity + the repo's most important look-ahead-bias gate.

nodes.title: Tier F2xx — Proof Backtest (NEXT)
nodes.content: F201: cheap rule-based sentiment scorer, paired t-test on t+5 dip / t+30 reversion hypothesis. Not started -- open questions: scoring rule, real news-data sufficiency, pilot-universe strategy.

nodes.title: Tier F3xx — Model Layer (BLOCKED on F201)
nodes.content: F301 PhoBERT-base fine-tune, F302 re-run backtest with SLM scores. Does not start until F201 shows statistical significance.

nodes.title: Tier F4xx — Deployment (not started)
nodes.content: F401 read-only inference service, F402 feedback log for drift monitoring.

nodes.title: Tier F9xx — Execution (BLOCKED, compliance gate)
nodes.content: F901 broker compliance confirmation, F902 sandbox paper trading. Legal blocker, not engineering -- does not start until F901 is a real signed-off document.

nodes.title: F000 — Environment & schema bootstrap
nodes.content: DuckDB staging/core/meta schemas, meta.crawl_progress table. Passing.

nodes.title: F001 — dim_symbol reference crawler
nodes.content: ~1525 symbols via vnstock Reference API. Delisted symbols unavailable (accepted, documented gap, enforced via xfail). Passing.

nodes.title: F002 — Market OHLCV daily crawler
nodes.content: Confirmed live schema (time/open/high/low/close/volume). Passing.

nodes.title: F003 — vnstock news crawler
nodes.content: ~50 most recent articles/symbol, no pagination. Deprioritized (documented HTTP 500 flakiness), built with F008 retry-awareness from the start. Passing.

nodes.title: F004 — cafef.vn news scraper
nodes.content: Page-1-only (~28 items), robots.txt-compliant. Real dead-end URL documented. Redundancy/cross-validation source, NOT a depth enhancement over F003.

nodes.title: F005 — Fundamental crawler suite
nodes.content: Pivoted-schema melt logic. balance_sheet empty-response accepted as real API gap. Passing.

nodes.title: F006 — Corporate events crawler
nodes.content: Confirmed real closed-set category field (DIVIDEND/MAJOR_SHAREHOLDER_TRADING/OTHER/SHAREHOLDER_MEETING). Full history by default. Passing.

nodes.title: F007 — Realtime quote snapshot (scope shrunk)
nodes.content: Only realtime quote implemented (Trading.price_board, 82-col MultiIndex). Valuation history/screener/rankings have no confirmed free-tier method. Passing.

nodes.title: F008 — Retry/reconciliation module
nodes.content: EmptyResultError vs transient failure distinction, meta.crawl_progress-backed retry budget. Passing.

nodes.title: F009 — Tier checkpoint: F0xx audit & remediation
nodes.content: New reusable convention: re-verify tier with fresh evidence before next tier starts. 8 items resolved this pass.

nodes.title: Found: F007 evidence was fabricated
nodes.content: 5-snapshot-type claim had no matching code and no matching DECISIONS.md entry. Retracted, reverted to real scope.

nodes.title: Fixed: fundamentals revision-overwrite look-ahead bug
nodes.content: PRIMARY KEY changed to include fetched_at; write_statements() now append-only with change detection. get_as_reported() and get_as_of() added for explicit vintage selection. Real migration written to preserve already-crawled data.

nodes.title: Added: corporate-action price adjustment
nodes.content: vnstock exposes no adjusted-price data. Computed downstream from F006 events (dividend/share-issue). Explicitly flagged UNVALIDATED against a real published adjusted-price series.

nodes.title: Added: news near-duplicate flagging
nodes.content: duplicate_of column, difflib-based heuristic across F003/F004. Flags, never deletes.

nodes.title: Added: resumable batch orchestrator
nodes.content: On top of F008's meta.crawl_progress. Verified: interrupted-then-resumed run never re-crawls an already-succeeded symbol.

nodes.title: F101 — Cross-dataset validation gate
nodes.content: Orphan-symbol and future-timestamp checks across all core tables, plus adjustment-event traceback to corporate_events. Passing.

nodes.title: F102 — Point-in-time news+price+fundamental join
nodes.content: The single most important look-ahead-bias gate in the repo. Trading-day offsets, adjusted prices, get_as_of() fundamentals, duplicate-filtered news. Passing.

nodes.title: Two explicit look-ahead-bias tests
nodes.content: 1) Post-market-close news not joined to same-day close. 2) A fundamental restatement fetched after published_at does not leak backward into the join.

nodes.title: F201 — PROOF: sentiment mean-reversion backtest (NEXT)
nodes.content: Rule-based scorer on F102's events table. Paired t-test: does t+5 dip after negative sentiment revert by t+30? Not started.

nodes.title: OPEN: sentiment scoring rule undefined
nodes.content: Spec says 'rule-based, not the SLM yet' but doesn't specify the rule. Needs a decision before F201 code starts.

nodes.title: OPEN: real news data sufficiency for a meaningful sample
nodes.content: F003/F004 news depth only accumulates FORWARD from first crawl -- cannot be backfilled. F201 cannot run on a deep historical sample until enough real news accumulates post-crawl-start.

nodes.title: Data crawl strategy discussion
nodes.content: Full ~1800-symbol universe confirmed as target. Key findings: date-range does NOT reduce crawl time (one API call regardless); real lever is symbol-count; resumability already solved/tested; cafef is redundancy not depth; news depth structurally capped; macro/index data is a stronger enhancement candidate than a second news source.

nodes.title: Recommendation: pilot universe first
nodes.content: Run VN30 / top ~100-200 liquid symbols through the full pipeline (F002/F005/F006 -> F101 -> F102) before committing to the full ~1800-symbol multi-hour run. Validates F201's statistics on a fast loop.

nodes.title: Recommendation: start news crawl in parallel, not after
nodes.content: Since news depth can only accumulate forward, delaying its start is unrecoverable lost time -- run a slow backgrounded F003/F004 crawl alongside the stock-data-first crawl, not strictly after it.
